تقتووا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَوُوا (taqtawū) /taq.ta.wuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# تُقْتَوَوْا (tuqtawaw) /tuq.ta.waw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
